plan.state: FOUNDATION COMPLETE. Engine vendored at 6703c00, digest built (32 sections), fields.json and precision.json generated from the one tolerance derivation, 18 graded fields discriminating against 94 wrong methods, oracle replay in exact rationals, lab and three panels shipped with vitest, route /dashboard/apps/lopa registered. plan.thesis: A layer of protection analysis finds how much risk reduction a scenario still needs and a SIF has to supply it. Associate owns HOW MUCH IS MISSING, Professional owns WHAT THE SIF ACHIEVES, Expert owns HOW LONG THE PROOF TEST MAY RUN AND WHAT THE ENGINE DOES NOT KNOW. Each capstone grades only its own tier's question.

tiers.beginner: Associate: LOPA arithmetic. m01 the scenario and its frequency (units, the refusals), m02 enabling conditions and conditional modifiers, m03 IPLs, independence, the auditable flag and one credit per IPL, m04 the TMEL, the required RRF, the required PFDavg as the binding target and the loop through a proposed SIF, m05 six outcome states, the low demand bands, the exact decade and the snap, m06 one worksheet end to end and the risk matrix seam. Digest sections 1 to 13.
tiers.intermediate: Professional: PFDavg. m01 the simplified forms and the half in 1oo1, m02 the full Annex B form (detected failures and MTTR, tCE and tGE, MRT, proof test coverage), m03 common cause, the beta factor and betaD, no beta factor term in 2oo2, m04 1oo2, 2oo3 and its six, 1oo3, m05 the SIF as a series sum, achieved RRF and SIL, back to the TMEL, m06 the published worked SIF reproduced, the warnings and refusals. Digest sections 14 to 24.
tiers.advanced: Expert: the proof test and judgement. m01 sensitivity, linear and quadratic growth, the longest interval and its states, m02 coverage, the floor and the lifetime cap, m03 how conservative Annex B is against the time dependent route, m04 the published example's inferred MRT, lifetime and beta factor slip, m05 what the engine does not do (no HFT check, no PFH, no failure-rate data, the credit rules are specification), m06 allocating a budget, stretching an interval, when to redesign, the verification note. Digest sections 25 to 31.

evidence.LOPA frequencies, RRF and PFDavg: exact arithmetic; the oracle decides every product and boundary in exact rationals; oracle_check.py replays all six Associate fields and the Usan loop exactly
evidence.1oo1, 1oo2, 2oo3 with DD, MTTR and MRT: two independent sources (Lundteigen and Rausand; the 61508 Association) state the same Annex B equations and the published worked SIF reproduces to three figures with MRT = MTTR; every capstone subsystem with detected failures keeps MRT = MTTR
evidence.2oo2: the Annex B form the engine prints; the simplified identity holds exactly; graded as the engine's declared convention, with its conservatism taught from the golden's route B
evidence.SIF sum: Annex B.3.2.1 as the published total reproduces it
evidence.longest interval: the oracle solves the exact polynomial in T1; oracle_check.py agrees to 1e-10
evidence.proof test coverage: the 61508 Association statement of Annex B.3.2.5, reproducing four published rows at an inferred T2 of 10 years; every capstone STATES its lifetime
evidence.never graded: 1oo3 (first-order route B only, no published row), route B values, the auditable flag (shared control green), a SIL number or state word on its own, the choice of IEF, TMEL or IPL PFD, HFT, PFH

history.position: THIS ENGINE HAS NO REPAIR HISTORY: written, oracle-gated and merged in one pull request. No history module, no framed history section; structure.py and digest_prose.rules.mjs refuse any key, title or heading that reads as one. The published example's inferred inputs (digest section 29) are facts about a published source.

scopeSeams.the 5x5 risk matrix: OWNED BY riskchange (and EC6's second scale). LOPA is frequency based and this course never grades a matrix band; digest section 13 states the seam and gate_vocabulary.py forbids bare 'severity' and stray 'likelihood'.
scopeSeams.licensed tables: IEC 61508/61511 and ISA tables are never reproduced; failure rates are inputs, labelled illustrative; the HFT architectural constraint is out of the engine and taught as such.
scopeSeams.consequence modelling: WILL BE OWNED BY H4 consequence. H3 takes a consequence as described and carried by its TMEL.

namingCollisions.beta: a vapour fraction (fluid), an orifice diameter ratio (metering) and more (fiscal, welldesign, earthmodel). Always 'beta factor'. Gated.
namingCollisions.PFD: always PFDavg for a SIF or subsystem, 'IPL PFD' for an IPL. Gated.
namingCollisions.severity: a risk-matrix category (riskchange, compliance) and other scales. Never used. Gated.
namingCollisions.likelihood: a matrix likelihood score (riskchange) and a Bayesian likelihood (decision). Only inside the TMEL's name. Gated.
namingCollisions.RRF: the risk reduction factor; 'risk reduction ratio' is gated.
